objective: Remove unapproved D outer implementation dependencies, preserving approved protocol and callback composition.
not_zero_runtime_peers: One broker-death callback slot, two F implementations: NTVDM worker_lifecycle.c::service_lost and NTVWM main.c::service_lost.
64 generated RPC server-dispatch/context-rundown rows to NTSRV.
Package resource identity and launcher/hook path contracts.

callback_contract.thread: D broker_lifetime_watch thread waits stop or authenticated service process; calls subscriber inline on confirmed service death. No extra queue.
callback_contract.registration: F composes through E worker_base_watch_service. D borrows callback/context.
callback_contract.normal_release: StopBrokerWatch sets stop, joins watcher, closes wait objects then clears callback/context. Both F teardown paths call unwatch before freeing state.
callback_contract.terminal_path: F owns process cleanup and terminal result; D first latches connection failure.
callback_contract.other_pointers: execution_cleanup -> D reset_launch; command activation -> B compat_console_activate; worker query pointers -> D protocol wrappers/stubs; native-hook consume callbacks -> D packet parser; helper process creation -> system CreateProcessW.

coverage: Current x86 worker/WOW/Hook/redir/VCDEX plus native x64 products and reference x86 graph; includes from ninja deps, live COFF relocations matched to final linker maps, source dynamic-call scan. VDMREDIR map produced with current exact objects/archives and original link flags into analysis-only output.

coverage_gap_disposition.largeint_movemem: C ASM files have no INCLUDE; no D source hidden.
coverage_gap_disposition.callpr32: C assembler includes C callconv.inc only.
coverage_gap_disposition.WOW_generated_bridge: Build-only F DllMain calls C W32DllInitialize and B shutdown bindings; not D.
